name: Dang Vu (Matt)
paragraphs: I started in April 2022 as a developer trainee at FPT Software. Four months of learning that most of software is other people. In November 2023 I joined Bravebits and spent almost two years on PageFly, a page builder merchants use for their storefronts.

Early on I measured myself by how much I shipped. By the end I measured myself by how little of it came back. Somewhere in between I stopped trusting my instincts about why something was slow or broken and started checking, which is a less flattering way to work but a much more reliable one. That is the habit I kept.

From September 2025 to November 2026 I was at sending.ac, building the product from the ground up with a small team of genuinely good engineers. It was the first time I had worked at real startup pace: short sprints, decisions made in a day, the whole surface up for grabs. I took features from nothing to working and I was the one paged when they broke, which quietly changed how I write everything.
In my free time I play with Rust, mostly by sending small patches to tensorzero and nextest.
